sources.method: RCGS record https://collection.rcgs.jp/page/DEVICE0000515 publishes 10 * 14 * 6 cm. RCGS Game Cataloging Manual v1.00, p.24 (https://www.rcgs.jp/wp-content/uploads/2019/06/manual_ver100.pdf), defines the physical dimension order as height × width × depth in cm. Multiply each recorded axis by 10: height 100 mm, width 140 mm, depth 60 mm. This is the catalogue measurement frame, not an inferred gameplay/body pose or a manufacturing tolerance.

notes: Exact catalogued physical specimen DEVICE0000515, not a universal DOL-003 model envelope, a retail stock code, manufacturing revision or proof of inclusion with a console. The museum names DOL-003, black and MADE IN JAPAN; its only stated information source is the physical device (装置現物). Market region and manufacture date are unresolved.

The catalogue size 10 * 14 * 6 cm is preserved verbatim. Only the documented H/W/D axis order and cm-to-mm conversion are derived. Pose/orientation, whether sticks/buttons/cable projections are included and cable arrangement are unpublished; excludes_projections and measurement_pose remain null. The state is catalogued, deliberately not body/shell/closed; normal fit and device-family mappings must not silently consume it.

Family remains null until a generator explicitly supports this source frame and scope. No traced controller outline, controls, internals, cable length, connector geometry or physical-fit claim is supplied. The generic nintendo-gamecube-controller object is unchanged.

RCGS DEVICE0000438 reports 6.7 × 13.5 × 11 cm, while DEVICE0000515 reports 10 × 14 × 6 cm for another black DOL-003 specimen. The reason for the differing extents/pose/rounding is unresolved; neither is silently preferred or merged into the other. This record retains its own catalogue extent. The modern Wii U/Switch-era DOL-003 manual does not establish the original 2001 pack-in dimensions.

Reported precision is retained: no conversion adds a manufacturing tolerance or a digit absent from the source. No complete bundled/contents relationship is asserted for RCGS DEVICE0000404 or any retail GameCube pack.
